action.description: survey: record shapes only, free. audit: map the records and report against the profile. resume: continue an incomplete audit. assess: re-test saved patterns against a log with no model call.

artifact_id.description: Artifact id of the log file.

file_path.description: Path to the log file, as an alternative to artifact_id.

profile_artifact_id.description: Artifact id of the requirement profile JSON. Required for audit, resume and assess.

profile_path.description: Path to the requirement profile JSON, as an alternative to profile_artifact_id.

state_artifact_id.description: Artifact id of a previous run's result or extraction spec. Required for resume and assess.

state_path.description: Path to the same file, as an alternative to state_artifact_id.

max_rounds.description: Model rounds allowed in this run.

target_coverage.description: Share of records that must match a pattern before mapping counts as complete.

sample_lines.description: Most log lines shown to the model in the first round.

max_records.description: Read only the first N records of the file. Default is the whole file.

time_budget_seconds.description: Stop starting model calls after this long and save what was mapped.

thinking_level.description: Reasoning depth requested for pattern proposals. Higher is slower.
